text: Does anyone have the link to the new travel policy? No rush.
reply_text:
I couldn't find a link to the new travel policy, so I told Hollis that in our DM rather than guess at a URL.

I only checked places Hollis can see himself:
- **Shared files:** none of the files he can access are a travel policy.
- **Channels:** #general and #help-it-ops are empty. #central-team and #central-random have older messages, but none of them mention a travel policy.
- **Knowledge brain:** a search found nothing on it. That search could only match exact keywords, so a page worded differently might have been missed.

I suggested he ask HR or Finance, or post in #general. I also told him I'd pass the link on if it turns up somewhere I can see. I haven't set anything up to watch for it, though, so I won't follow up unless someone asks me again.
